profile.strategy_title: National Agenda for Artificial Intelligence (2020, updated pathways)
profile.regulation_summary: Sectoral and data-protection rules apply; no comprehensive AI law yet. Privacy anchored in LFPDPPP. Active discussion on AI sandboxes and federal coordination.
profile.responsible_bodies: CONACYT / SECIHTI, Ministry of Economy, INAI (data protection), digital transformation units
profile.privacy: Federal data protection law; consent and purpose limitation; cross-border transfer rules
profile.generative_ai: Emerging guidance; public-sector pilots with transparency expectations
profile.education: STEM and AI skills in higher education; national digital skills programs
profile.risks: Bias in public services, labor displacement, weak enforcement capacity, cybersecurity

profile.strategy_title: Executive Order on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy AI (2023) + NIST AI RMF
profile.regulation_summary: Sectoral federal approach; state-level AI laws emerging. NIST AI Risk Management Framework widely adopted voluntarily. FTC and agencies active on consumer protection.
profile.responsible_bodies: NIST, White House OSTP, FTC, sector regulators (FDA, SEC, etc.)
profile.regulatory_approach: Sectoral + voluntary standards + emerging state law
profile.privacy: No federal comprehensive privacy law; state laws (CA, etc.)
profile.generative_ai: EO requirements for federal use; industry commitments; watermarking R&D
profile.education: NSF AI institutes; workforce reskilling initiatives
profile.risks: Dual-use AI, election integrity, discrimination, IP, critical infrastructure

profile.regulation_summary: EU AI Act applies as Member State. National AI Commission (CNNum). Strong focus on sovereign compute and public-sector AI.
profile.privacy: GDPR + CNIL enforcement; DPIA for high-risk processing
profile.generative_ai: EU AI Act GPAI obligations; national transparency initiatives
profile.education: AI majors expansion; lifelong learning vouchers
profile.risks: Compliance costs for SMEs, concentration in Big Tech, bias in welfare systems

profile.regulation_summary: EU AI Act + strong data protection tradition. Federal ministries coordinate research and industrial policy. Ethics Council input on automated decision-making.
profile.responsible_bodies: BMWK, BMBF, BSI, data protection authorities (Länder + federal)
profile.regulatory_approach: Risk-based EU framework + strict privacy culture
profile.privacy: GDPR gold standard enforcement; works councils and co-determination in workplace AI
profile.generative_ai: EU GPAI rules; industry codes; public research on foundation models
profile.education: Dual education system integration; AI in vocational training
profile.risks: Over-regulation perception, innovation lag vs US/China, bureaucratic fragmentation

profile.regulation_summary: LGPD for data protection. AI legal framework under legislative debate. National AI plan linked to digital government.
profile.regulatory_approach: Rights-based data law + evolving AI-specific rules
profile.privacy: LGPD aligned with GDPR principles; ANPD enforcement ramping up
profile.generative_ai: Draft bills address liability and transparency; agency guidance emerging
profile.education: National STEM programs; university AI research networks
profile.risks: Digital divide, enforcement gaps, misinformation in elections

profile.strategy_title: Pan-Canadian AI Strategy + AIDA proposal trajectory
profile.regulation_summary: Voluntary AI Code of Practice; proposed Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA) under C-27 debate. Strong research hubs (Mila, Vector, Amii).
profile.responsible_bodies: ISED, Office of the Privacy Commissioner, CIFAR
profile.privacy: PIPEDA reform discussions; provincial laws (Quebec Law 25)
profile.generative_ai: Voluntary commitments; AIDA high-impact system obligations if enacted
profile.education: CIFAR chairs; national AI scholarship programs
profile.risks: Regulatory uncertainty during AIDA debate, brain drain to US, indigenous data rights

frameworks.title: Voluntary Code of Conduct on Responsible AI

profile.strategy_title: AI Regulation White Paper / pro-innovation approach
profile.regulation_summary: Cross-sectoral principles for regulators instead of single AI law. AI Safety Institute. GDPR UK retained law.
profile.responsible_bodies: DSIT, ICO, sector regulators, AI Safety Institute
profile.generative_ai: Safety testing; copyright and IP policy active debate
profile.education: Alan Turing Institute; school computing curriculum
profile.risks: Regulatory fragmentation across sectors, adequacy with EU data flows

profile.strategy_title: EU Coordinated Plan on AI + AI Act
profile.regulation_summary: EU AI Act: risk-based binding regulation for AI systems in the EU market. Digital Omnibus updates expected. Horizon Europe funds AI research.
profile.responsible_bodies: European Commission (DG CNECT), EU AI Office, national competent authorities
profile.privacy: GDPR interaction with AI Act; special categories and DPIA
profile.generative_ai: GPAI model obligations: transparency, copyright policy, systemic risk for frontier models
profile.education: Digital Education Action Plan; Erasmus+ digital skills
profile.risks: Innovation friction, compliance complexity, enforcement heterogeneity across MS
